attestations.text: WAN Yen 萬言 (T. 貞一, H. 管村), Aug. 25, 1637–1705, May 8, scholar, son of Wan Ssŭ-nien (see under Wan T'ai), was a native of Yin-hsien, Chekiang. Like his father and his uncles, he was a pupil of Huang Tsung-hsi [q. v.] and distinguished himself as an essayist.
